pages.text: Where the rainforest runs right down to the sea, the day is ending. Tilly the tree-kangaroo yawns high in her tree.
The cassowary walks her chicks home through the ferns, one slow step at a time.
The kookaburras have one last laugh. Then, quiet.
The green tree frogs sit in a row on a big leaf, plump and still.
The flying foxes wake up! They stretch their wings and flap off to find fruit.
The turtle crawls up the beach to dig her nest in the warm sand.
The blue Ulysses butterfly folds his bright wings shut and looks just like a brown leaf.
The possum peeks out of her hollow, ready for a night of climbing.
Down on the reef, the little fish snuggle into their coral for the night.
Tilly climbs down, and down, and down to her sleeping branch.
The rain comes, warm and soft, tapping on a million leaves.
Goodnight, rainforest. Goodnight, reef. Goodnight, Tilly.
